rationale: The stock gapped up ~12% on mixed earnings (revenue beat but significant EPS miss, no revenue growth), and price is now consolidating near VWAP with the last 5 candles showing indecision and slight downward drift — no clear directional momentum. The negative earnings catalyst (EPS miss of -18.37%, flat revenue) creates overhead resistance and fade risk, but the gap has already partially digested and the broad market is modestly weak today, making a clean setup in either direction unclear. With two working orders already consuming buying power and today's realized P&L already negative, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure here.
